proposal.quote: they would be happier to see us maintain the strict position of neutrality called for by the letter of existing law
proposal.rule: claude backend: Isolationist covers the Neutrality Act regime with a mandatory arms embargo; the passage shows the existing neutrality law still in force, while the embargo itself is only implied and the rest of the document discusses recommendations.

proposal.quote: the belligerent, designated by the League as the aggressor
proposal.rule: claude backend: Italy is estranged from the West after Ethiopia; the passage shows the League naming Italy, a belligerent in the Italo-Ethiopian conflict, as the aggressor, with sanctions under discussion elsewhere in the document.

proposal.quote: sitting in conference with Germany to negotiate a new naval agreement would be construed as a condonement of Germany’s violation of the Treaty of Versailles
proposal.rule: claude backend: Eroded: the passage treats a German violation of Versailles as standing and protested, and the Anglo-German naval accord in force, with no enforcement by force, which matches the eroded level.

proposal.quote: the sanctions already in effect are rapidly curtailing Italy’s resources
proposal.rule: claude backend: italy_estranged is true while League sanctions against Italy over Ethiopia are in force, and the passage reports those sanctions as in effect.

proposal.quote: Under the Anglo-German agreement giving Germany a 35 per cent ratio with the British fleet
proposal.rule: claude backend: The eroded level cites the Anglo-German Naval Agreement, which accepted German naval rearmament beyond Part V, and the passage shows it in force; the document says nothing about the Rhineland zone.

proposal.quote: French acquiescence in German participation would, in a measure, condone the violation of the military clauses of the Treaty of Versailles ... a further violation of the treaty through the military occupation of the Rhineland
proposal.rule: claude backend: eroded: Versailles military-clause violations are treated as having occurred without enforcement, while the Rhineland zone's occupation is still only a feared future violation, so the zone still stands.

proposal.quote: a step over which the French are very apprehensive, namely, a further violation of the treaty through the military occupation of the Rhineland
proposal.rule: claude backend: demilitarized: the military occupation of the Rhineland is described as a feared future step, not as German troops already garrisoned in the zone.

proposal.quote: The British continue to favor an approach to Germany whenever it can be determined that a reasonable and promising basis for negotiation has been evolved.
proposal.rule: claude backend: limited: British policy, as reported, treats German aims as revision open to a negotiated settlement through concessions, not as a drive for domination.

proposal.quote: British foreign policy will be fundamentally based on the idea of temporization
proposal.rule: claude backend: appease: policy seeks a settlement and avoids antagonizing Germany, there is no commitment beyond Locarno, and rearmament is described as largely replacement and repair outside the air arm.

proposal.quote: The efficacy of financial and economic sanctions
proposal.rule: claude backend: italy_estranged true: League sanctions against Italy are reported as in force and as working, so Italy remains estranged from the West over Ethiopia.

proposal.quote: Great Britain would stand by Locarno but would refuse to make more precise the provisions of that pact and particularly in such a way as to alienate Germany and close the door to any possible appeasement with Germany
proposal.rule: claude backend: appease: the Foreign Secretary declines any commitment beyond Locarno and keeps policy aimed at a settlement with Germany.

proposal.quote: Great Britain considered it of vital importance to get a naval agreement and that in order to get it it was essential that Germany should be brought in
proposal.rule: claude backend: limited: a minister treats Germany as a partner to be brought into negotiated agreements and seeks to keep open 'appeasement with Germany', implying German aims can be satisfied by settlement; this is a second-hand private remark, not a Cabinet record.

proposal.quote: it was unlikely that the Germans had at the moment any warlike intentions, provided something could be done to satisfy her needs for raw materials and some territorial expansion for her excess population
proposal.rule: claude backend: The 'limited' rule applies: the French Prime Minister treats German aims as needs that a negotiated general settlement could satisfy, and proposes an international conference to that end.

proposal.quote: if such an agreement is to be satisfactory and effective it is essential that Germany be a party
proposal.rule: claude backend: Under the limited rule, the Foreign Secretary seeks an unconditional naval agreement with Germany as a party, which treats German aims as open to negotiated settlement; but it is a single ministerial line on arms limitation, not a Cabinet conclusion.

proposal.quote: there has been no such settlement and the British fleet was still in the Mediterranean
proposal.rule: claude backend: italy_estranged is true while Italy is estranged from the West over Ethiopia and sanctions; the passage reports the Abyssinian question unsettled and the British fleet still in the Mediterranean, with Mussolini reluctant to sign a naval agreement with the Western powers.

proposal.quote: no definite political or military understanding exists between Germany and Italy
proposal.rule: claude backend: The axis flag is true only with a Rome-Berlin alignment such as the October Protocols; here the US ambassador judges that no political or military understanding exists, and Suvich denies any alliance plan.

proposal.quote: to continue in the League in spite of existing sanctions ... will not sign nor make this or any other new engagements nor assume any new obligations with any sanctioning government or governments pending the sanctions régime
proposal.rule: claude backend: Italy remains estranged from the West: the League sanctions over Ethiopia are still in force, and Italy refuses new engagements with the sanctioning governments.

proposal.quote: the Italians indicated that they would find it difficult to justify signing a naval agreement so long as sanctions are being applied against Italy
proposal.rule: claude backend: The rule defends estrangement by League sanctions against Italy remaining in force; the passage reports sanctions still being applied and Italy making its cooperation with the Western powers conditional on them.

proposal.quote: as long as Italy was at war and sanctions are being applied against her with the threat of military measures, it was not possible to find any way to do so which would not have a harmful effect on public opinion
proposal.rule: claude backend: Italy estranged from the West after Ethiopia, defended by League sanctions in force; the Italian ambassador reports sanctions still applied and Italy refusing a naval agreement with the Western powers on that account.

proposal.quote: H. J. Res. 491, extending until May 1, 1937, Section 1 of the Joint Resolution (Public Resolution No. 67, 74th Congress), approved August 31, 1935, and making certain other amendments, has recently been passed by Congress and is now awaiting approval by the President.
proposal.rule: claude backend: The isolationist level is defined by the Neutrality Act regime of 31 Aug 1935 and its extension of Feb 1936; the passage shows that regime in force and being extended by Congress, though the text does not itself describe Section 1 as the arms embargo.

proposal.quote: the fundamental reason for their inability to commit themselves now on a naval agreement is political ... as long as sanctions are being applied against Italy with the threat of military force
proposal.rule: claude backend: The italy_estranged rule treats League sanctions against Italy in force after Ethiopia as the mark of estrangement; this passage reports sanctions still applied and Italy refusing, for political reasons, to join a naval treaty with Britain, France and the United States.

proposal.quote: the Italian Government was unable at this time to enter into a naval treaty ... the sanctions now pending against Italy and the unsatisfactory reply of the British Government to the Italian representations regarding mutual assistance against Italy
proposal.rule: claude backend: italy_estranged is true while League sanctions against Italy are in force and Italy is at odds with the West; Italy here refuses a naval treaty, citing the pending sanctions and British mutual-assistance arrangements against it.

proposal.quote: the symbolical act of the entry into the demilitarized zone this noon of several battalions of the regular army
proposal.rule: claude backend: Remilitarized means German troops in the zone; the 4 p.m. telegram reports the German Foreign Office's account of regular army battalions entering the zone at noon, and the memorandum read in the Reichstag states that full sovereignty in the zone has been restored.

proposal.quote: He thought the act of Germany in actually sending soldiers into the zone was a tactical and psychological error
proposal.rule: claude backend: Remilitarized means German troops garrisoned in the zone; the passage reports that Germany has actually sent soldiers into the demilitarized zone.

proposal.quote: the sanctions which now were being applied against Italy
proposal.rule: claude backend: The italy_estranged rule rests on League sanctions against Italy being in force, and the passage reports them as still applied on the document's date.

proposal.quote: should Germany remilitarize the Rhineland zone, yesterday’s news caused great surprise
proposal.rule: claude backend: Remilitarized means German troops garrisoned in the zone. The dispatch implies that the news of 7 March was the remilitarization the Cabinet had been considering, but it does not explicitly describe troops in the zone.

proposal.quote: the drastic action in reoccupying the demilitarized zone ... Major Smith believes the following cities have been garrisoned to date: Dusseldorf, Cologne, Aachen, Coblenz, Mainz, Saarbrucken, Trier, Frankfurt, Mannheim, Karlsruhe.
proposal.rule: claude backend: Remilitarized means German troops garrisoned in the zone; the dispatch reports the zone reoccupied and named Rhineland cities garrisoned.

proposal.quote: the unilateral repudiation of a treaty followed up by military force
proposal.rule: claude backend: Remilitarized requires German troops in the zone; the French Foreign Minister refers to the treaty repudiation as already 'followed up by military force', but the document does not state outright that troops are garrisoned there.

proposal.quote: France will not mobilize at present and was taking no military measures beyond slightly reinforcing the garrisons of the frontier fortresses
proposal.rule: claude backend: Appease holds because France declines a military response to the Rhineland move (no resist_rhineland branch), taking only minor garrison measures.

proposal.quote: the principal desire of our country as recently expressed and frequently reenforced by declarations of the Executive and acts of Congress was to remain neutral
proposal.rule: claude backend: Isolationist means the Neutrality Act regime with an arms embargo on belligerents; the ambassador confirms US neutrality legislation and action on arms shipments to belligerents.

proposal.quote: under the régime of sanctions now applying to that country
proposal.rule: claude backend: Italy_estranged is defended by League sanctions against Italy remaining in force, which the passage states.

proposal.quote: the action taken by the German Government in sending troops into that part of the Rhine zone which was demilitarized under the Treaty of Versailles
proposal.rule: claude backend: The remilitarized level requires German troops in the zone, and the passage reports that Germany has sent troops into the demilitarized Rhine zone.

proposal.quote: It is difficult to forecast what the effect of the Rhineland occupation and of the tearing up of Locarno will be
proposal.rule: claude backend: Remilitarized means German troops garrisoned in the zone; the memorandum treats the German reoccupation of the Rhineland on March 7 as an accomplished fact.
